title: Centre for New Economy and Society - Home
gist: Landing page of the WEF Centre for the New Economy and Society (preceded by cookie boilerplate): lists initiatives on growth, reskilling and gender parity with reach statistics; promotional with little analytical content.

insights.claim: The Centre organises its work into three pillars: economic growth and risk preparedness, talent and human capital, and equity and inclusion, via the Future of Growth Initiative, Reskilling Revolution Initiative and Global Parity Sprint 2030.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.so_what: Indicates WEF's policy agenda priorities: skills and gender parity.

insights.claim: The Forum says its Reskilling Revolution platform has reached more than 350 million people since January 2020, and Gender Parity Accelerators in 14 countries are helping close economic gender gaps benefitting over 850,000 women.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
